title: The Structure of Disagreement in Emotion Annotation
abstract: arXiv:2611.01539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Calculating inter-annotator agreement is an established practice in NLP, and disagreement-aware work increasingly retains the distribution of human judgments rather than reducing annotations to a single gold label. Keeping the distribution, however, does not explain why annotators disagree. This paper examines the types of disagreement that occur in emotion annotation, starting from multilabel annotations of 1,677 sentence-level units from Ernest Hemingway's The Old Man and the Sea and testing the patterns they reveal against individual-level annotations from BRIGHTER and GoEmotions. Across the three datasets, we find three main recurring disagreement structures. Emotion categories overlap systematically; annotators differ both in how broadly they apply labels and in how they treat particular category boundaries, while sparse participation and explicit abstention can look like disagreement. translated_title: 情感标注中的分歧结构
translated_abstract: 计算标注者间一致性是自然语言处理中的一项成熟实践，而关注分歧的研究工作越来越多地保留人类判断的分布，而不是将标注简化为单一的金标准标签。然而，保留分布并不能解释标注者为什么会产生分歧。本文研究了情感标注中出现的分歧类型，首先基于对欧内斯特·海明威《老人与海》中1,677个句子级单元的多标签标注进行分析，并在BRIGHTER和GoEmotions数据集的个体级标注上检验这些标注所揭示的模式。在三个数据集中，我们发现了三种主要的反复出现的分歧结构：情感类别存在系统性的重叠；标注者不仅在其应用标签的宽泛程度上存在差异，在对特定类别边界的处理方式上也有所不同；同时，稀疏的参与和明确的弃权可能会被误认为分歧。在评估情感强度的地方，关于……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文通过分析《老人与海》以及BRIGHTER和GoEmotions数据集中的情感标注，首次系统揭示了三种反复出现的分歧结构——情感类别的系统性重叠、标注者在标签宽泛度与类别边界处理上的差异、以及稀疏参与和弃权被误认为分歧。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies three recurring disagreement structures in emotion annotation across three datasets: systematic overlap of emotion categories, annotator differences in label breadth and category boundary treatment, and sparse participation or explicit abstention that can mimic genuine disagreement.
